### Seeking God Before You Try to Save the Day
Author: Karen Del Tatto
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/seeking-god-before-you-try-to-save-the-day.html
Passage: Joshua 9:14
Points:
- Well-intentioned people often rush to solve others' problems using human wisdom instead of prayer.
- Israel entered into a covenant with the deceptive Gibeonites because they failed to ask the Lord's counsel.
- Rushing in to rescue someone prematurely can disrupt what God wants to teach them through hardship.
- Believers need discernment before intervening, recognizing that not every helpful instinct aligns with God's will.
- Pointing people to the true Savior is far better than pridefully trying to rescue them ourselves.

### The Secret Failure of Many Leaders
Author: Greg Morse
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-secret-failure-of-many-leaders
Passage: Joshua 9:14
Points:
- Joshua was a faithful and courageous leader who stumbled by trusting his physical senses rather than consulting God.
- Success often lures leaders into spiritual autopilot, relying on past victories instead of present prayer.
- Prayerlessness rarely begins as deliberate rebellion; it creeps in through busyness and subtle self-reliance.
- Neglecting the Lord in everyday decisions leads to costly mistakes and spiritual barrenness.
- Jesus modeled true leadership by continually looking to the Father and seeking His will in all things.

### Grace for the Gibeonites
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://www.ligonier.org/learn/devotionals/grace-for-gibeonites
Passage: Joshua 9:15
Points:
- The Israelites were deceived by the Gibeonites because they leaned on their own understanding instead of asking God.
- Even after discovering the ruse, Joshua and the leaders honored their sworn treaty because godly people keep their vows.
- Though the Gibeonites deserved judgment under the law, they received unexpected mercy and were spared.
- The Gibeonites were integrated into Israelite life and service, eventually participating in rebuilding Jerusalem's walls.
- God's surprising mercy to deceptive outsiders illustrates how grace reaches those who come under the hearing of His truth.

### The Gibeonite Deception
Author: D.A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/joshua-9-psalms-140-141-jeremiah-3-matthew-17/
Passage: Joshua 9:14
Points:
- Believers capable of facing direct opposition often remain vulnerable to subtle deception and flattery.
- Deceptive teaching is especially dangerous when it mimics spiritual language and appears respectable.
- Israel's failure sprang from an overconfidence that assumed divine guidance was unnecessary in this situation.
- Neglecting to seek God's perspective through prayer and Scripture frequently leads leaders into serious error.
- Christians must guard against self-reliance by continually testing situations against God's Word.
